features.note: Near-cubic charcoal DIN body, no rack ears, sculpted rear spring-clip (hook + leaf + tab). The whole-asset mass drift blockout->final is x0/y0/z1.80mm, and the 1.80 is fully accounted: 100% the DIN latch, moving the RIGHT way — the blockout's crude tab reached z-0.0771, the sculpted leaf spring reaches -0.0753 (1.8mm shallower, because a real leaf spring hugs the body where a glued tab juts). Verified by measuring the rearmost mesh; nothing else moved on any axis.

5x2 = 10 recessed jacks, 8 RJ45 + 2 SFP (silver sleeve, keyway guard). SFP pop is at its accepted honest limit (the analytic rig proves aim not occlusion-survival; the distinction is genuinely subtle at real scale). Per-port LED strip shows the honest 8 green + 2 amber split in ?leds=on.

Six system LEDs down the left with correct labels (EIP MOD / EIP NET / SETUP / DC_A / DC_B / ALARM OUT), aligned by construction; ?leds=on lights them in a realistic mixed state (amber/green). This is the managed-switch identity cue and it reads.
Three removable screw-terminal blocks proud of the top face (12 screw heads), well-lit by the re-aimed rig. Reads from front and rear.

Livery reads in the hero: red Allen-Bradley logo, 'Stratix 5700', catalogue 1783-BMS10CGP. Text discipline held to the end and is ASSERTED (absence of electrical values, not just eyeballed) — no voltage/current/watts, no port numbering. Pure offline canvas-drawn art.

defects: SFP sleeve reads subtly at final exposure — accepted as the honest real-scale limit after three levers; not a defect to chase further.
Hero exposure is on the moody/dark side — appropriate for the aisle context.

notes: FINAL gate — inline orchestrator judgment. The stratix-5700 asset is COMPLETE. The full ladder held: envelope unmoved across seven passes, all criticals present and reading, text discipline and offline integrity verified independently by the orchestrator, honest LED states, budget trivially under, and every drift (the 1.8mm) accounted to a specific correct cause. This ladder was notably rigorous: the builder self-caught and fixed latent defects at almost every pass (z-fight guard on instanced hulls, wrap-around texture on box side-faces, a declared-but-uninstantiated led_amber, a console.log masquerading as an assertion, a pass-through occlusion pick(), a deleted import caught by an exercising check) and hardened each into a permanent guard. One accepted honest limit (SFP pop). Cleared. Remaining run work: UPS ladder, Axis, FMPS, and the scene assembly.
